Only RT Admins can process 503 — Work order is already completed. Verification data cannot be removed 503 — Follow-up date must equal the completed date 503 — Leak event should contain at least one leak record

request.name: Get leak verification methods for EPA Leak Inspection WOs

description.content:
Retrieves leak verification methods by WO tracking number. Only for Planned Maintenance work orders of the **EPA Leak Inspection** category where compliance acknowledgement is enabled by the subscriber.  • `1`: Soap Bubble Test  • `2`: Electronic Leak Detection  • `3`: Ultrasonic Leak Detection  • `4`: Pressure Test  • `5`: Vacuum Test  • `6`: Fluorescent Dye Test  • `7`: Infrared Test  • `8`: Near Infrared Test  • `9`: Halon Gas Detection
***Note***: Requires the *RefLeakInspectionAcknowledgement* and the *RTMultiLeakFlow* feature flags to be turned on.

item.name: Check if a WO requires secondary leak verification

request.name: Check if a WO requires secondary leak verification

description.content:
Checks if a work order has the associated leak record where the secondary leak verification date and method haven’t been provided yet.
Possible response values:  • `true`: There is an incomplete leak record linked to the specified work order ID. The secondary verification date and method are missing.  • `false`: There are no leak events for the specified work order ID, or the leak event associated with the WO was completed, with the secondary leak verification date and method provided.
Can be used by both providers and subscribers.
